<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using only the functional groups that are formed in the forward Still‑Gennari HWE reaction (a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester). This avoids invalid “broken” functional‑group filters.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
